reviewMethod: Independently read all 85 initial complete bilingual pairs and selected meanings/POS against every full frozen Chinese field, lexical evidence and variant, in untruncated ranges 0+30,30+30,60+25. Then read every one of the 115 non-retained frozen records in 60+55 ranges, covering all 200 queue records without approving author-deferred items. Actual canonical term/POS/meaning/variants match all 200 frozen records, normalizing absent variants and [] to none. This queue's evidence is published-Chinese-source-only, not WordNet or morphological equivalence. Individually checked actual head occurrence, POS/grammar, named-person versus common-noun use, selected-source fidelity, technical type, register, translation precision and naturalness. The exact initial locked TSV is preserved in qa/b-original-read-p049.tsv, and complete initial findings are preserved in qa/b-review-p049-findings.json. Following author-only revision, reread the five final complete rows and all their frozen source fields: altrose, alumel, alutation, alveolization and alyssa. Independently verified that these are the only five changed rows, the other 80 complete rows are byte-for-byte unchanged and all 85 terms retain original order. Reviewed the explicitly pinned noun-subtype evidence for Alumel in explicit-pos-evidence.json and actually read the manufacturer's primary trade-name entry. Reviewed root's explicit compressed-weathering-pattern adjudication of the terse alveolization source; the final label/translation now denote the supported cavity-forming weathering phenomenon, not an invented static-cavity noun or a new weathering mechanism. Frozen/canonical text was not repaired. Final compiled 85 entries equal the current locked TSV field-for-field and the current exact source hash is pinned. Mechanical checks establish freshness/provenance only, not language judgment.
